description: This file defines a class M4 representing a 4x4 float matrix with operations such as multiplication, setting to identity, and copying. It appears to be used for 3D graphics transformations in an Android Open Source Project sample.

classes.name: M4
classes.description: A class for 4x4 float matrix used in graphics transformations, providing methods for matrix multiplication, setting identity, and copying matrices.
